# f5xc_tf_params_action (Resource)

View terraform parameters object defines parameters to create external configs using terraform.

To get more information about f5xc_tf_params_action, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/views-terraform-parameters)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Tf Params Action - Basic

resource "f5xc_aws_vpc_site" "site" {
  name      = "example-tf-params-action-bn7a9d-909000"
  namespace = "system"

  vpc = {
    choice = {
      new_vpc = {
        name_choice = {
          autogenerate = true
        }
        primary_ipv4 = "10.10.0.0/16"
      }
    }
  }

  site_type_choice = {
    ingress_gw = {
      az_nodes = [{
        aws_az_name = "us-west-2a"
        local_subnet = {
          choice = {
            subnet_param = {
              ipv4 = "10.10.1.0/24"
            }
          }
        }
      }]
      aws_certified_hw = "aws-byol-voltmesh"
    }
  }

  deployment_choice = {
    aws_cred = {
      name      = "eric-aws-credential"
      namespace = "system"
    }
  }

  instance_type = "t3.xlarge"
  aws_region    = "us-west-2"
  ssh_key       = "ssh-rsa  y.kuo@FRVQMCXG9D"

  worker_nodes_choice = {
    no_worker_nodes = true
  }

  logs_receiver_choice = {
    logs_streaming_disabled = true
  }

  blocked_services_choice = {
    block_all_services = true
  }

  direct_connect_choice = {
    direct_connect_disabled = true
  }

  internet_vip_choice = {
    disable_internet_vip = true
  }

  egress_gateway_choice = {
    egress_gateway_default = true
  }

  security_group_choice = {
    f5xc_security_group = true
  }

  routing_type_choice = {
    f5_orchestrated_routing = true
  }

  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = all
  }
}

resource "f5xc_tf_params_action" "example" {
  namespace       = f5xc_aws_vpc_site.site.namespace
  view_kind       = "aws_vpc_site"
  view_name       = f5xc_aws_vpc_site.site.name
  action          = ["PLAN"]
  wait_for_action = true

  timeouts = {
    create = "30m"
    read   = "10m"
    delete = "10m"
  }

  depends_on = [f5xc_aws_vpc_site.site]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) Namespace Namespace for the label to be retrieved
- `view_kind` (String) Kind of View Kind of view of which terraform parameters are requested e.g. aws_vpc_site, azure_vnet_site
- `view_name` (String) Name of view Name of the view for which terraform parameters are requested

### Optional

- `action` (List of String) Terraform action to be performed Terraform action to be performed for a given view e.g. plan, apply<br>**Allowed Values (choose one):** `['APPLY', 'DESTROY', 'PLAN']`<br>**Default:** `APPLY`
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `wait_for_action` (Boolean) Wait for terraform action job completion before returning result.

### Read-Only

- `tf_output` (String) Terraform output emitted by apply action when wait_for_action is enabled.
